in_marathi.name: Nilambar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Blue lotus in the heart
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nilambar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nilambar is derived from Sanskrit, where Nila means blue and Ambar means lotus. This name signifies the presence of a blue lotus in one's heart. In Hindu mythology, the lotus symbolizes spiritual growth and enlightenment. Thus, Nilambar is a powerful name that represents the attainment of spiritual wisdom and inner peace.
